title: 協作機器人應用驗證
summary: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
summaryEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

options: 只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。

NIST 的協作工作站研究指出系統層驗證的重要；本課比較合成碰撞能量，並說明它不能單獨判定人機接觸安全。
optionsEn: A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed.
Use energy only to rank scenarios, not to authorize human contact; review tool, workspace and validation together.
NIST studies validation at workcell level; synthetic kinetic-energy comparisons illustrate why energy alone cannot establish contact safety.

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 平動近似E=mv²/2；相同能量可因接觸面積、剛性與受夾困條件產生不同後果。
knowledge.textEn: TranslationalE=mv²/2 is only an approximation; equal energy can have different consequences with area, stiffness and trapping.

quiz.question: 「整體應用邊界」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Whole-application boundary: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 把速度時間序列平方後逐點計能量，對照相同能量但不同接觸面積的兩個抽象情境。
只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。
純教學等效質量2 kg，速度0.20 m/s；不代表人體傷害或協作機器人允許值。
optionsEn: Square each speed sample to calculate energy; compare two abstract contacts with equal energy but different areas.
A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed.
Teaching effective mass 2 kg and speed 0.20 m/s; not injury thresholds or permissible collaborative-robot values.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。把速度時間序列平方後逐點計能量，對照相同能量但不同接觸面積的兩個抽象情境。 與本階段判準一起判讀：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Square each speed sample to calculate energy; compare two abstract contacts with equal energy but different areas. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

steps.title: 整體應用邊界 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Whole-application boundary · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「整體應用邊界」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Whole-application boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
把速度時間序列平方後逐點計能量，對照相同能量但不同接觸面積的兩個抽象情境。
回到本階段實驗：把機器人、工具、工件與外部護具視為同一應用邊界，逐一標記可能接觸位置。 NIST 的協作工作站研究指出系統層驗證的重要；本課比較合成碰撞能量，並說明它不能單獨判定人機接觸安全。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.instructionEn:
Square each speed sample to calculate energy; compare two abstract contacts with equal energy but different areas.
Return to the investigation: Include robot, tool, workpiece and external guards within the application boundary, marking potential contacts. NIST studies validation at workcell level; synthetic kinetic-energy comparisons illustrate why energy alone cannot establish contact safety.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。把速度時間序列平方後逐點計能量，對照相同能量但不同接觸面積的兩個抽象情境。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Square each speed sample to calculate energy; compare two abstract contacts with equal energy but different areas.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

quiz.question: 「整體應用邊界」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Whole-application boundary: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: E=0.5×2×0.20²=0.040 J；只代表此模型瞬間動能。
交付能量比較、接觸幾何、夾困情境與所缺驗證證據。
只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。
optionsEn: E=0.040 J, only the instantaneous kinetic energy of this model.
Deliver energy comparison, contact geometry, trapping scenarios and missing validation evidence.
A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。 與本階段判準一起判讀：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

steps.title: 整體應用邊界 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Whole-application boundary · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「整體應用邊界」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Whole-application boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。
對照「整體應用邊界」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。動能比較僅用於排序情境，不據此批准人員接觸；工具、工作區與驗證方法需整體審查。
本階段必須重驗：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.instructionEn:
A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed.
Against the nominal Whole-application boundary result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Use energy only to rank scenarios, not to authorize human contact; review tool, workspace and validation together.
Reverify this criterion: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。只引用機器人型號的協作標籤而漏掉尖銳工具、工件及夾困區，是應用層證據缺口。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A collaborative label on the robot omits tool edges, workpieces and trapping zones unless the application is assessed.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

quiz.question: 「整體應用邊界」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: Whole-application boundary: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 平動近似E=mv²/2；相同能量可因接觸面積、剛性與受夾困條件產生不同後果。
動能比較僅用於排序情境，不據此批准人員接觸；工具、工作區與驗證方法需整體審查。
NIST 的協作工作站研究指出系統層驗證的重要；本課比較合成碰撞能量，並說明它不能單獨判定人機接觸安全。

Use energy only to rank scenarios, not to authorize human contact; review tool, workspace and validation together.
NIST studies validation at workcell level; synthetic kinetic-energy comparisons illustrate why energy alone cannot establish contact safety.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。動能比較僅用於排序情境，不據此批准人員接觸；工具、工作區與驗證方法需整體審查。 與本階段判準一起判讀：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Use energy only to rank scenarios, not to authorize human contact; review tool, workspace and validation together. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.

steps.title: 整體應用邊界 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Whole-application boundary · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「整體應用邊界」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Whole-application boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付能量比較、接觸幾何、夾困情境與所缺驗證證據。
在交接件中加入「整體應用邊界」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver energy comparison, contact geometry, trapping scenarios and missing validation evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Whole-application boundary: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
